highlight.text: [Fresco] is a technique of mural painting executed upon freshly laid ("wet") lime plaster.

work.text: The attribution of the fresco cycle of the Life of St. Francis in the Upper Church has been one of the most disputed in art history.

moment.text: because, besides that which Giotto had from nature, he was most diligent and went on ever thinking out new ideas and wresting them from nature, he well deserved to be called the disciple of nature and not of others.

source.author: Giorgio Vasari
source.title: Life of Giotto, in Lives of the Most Eminent Painters, Sculptors and Architects (trans. Gaston du C. de Vere)

moment.lead: Vasari on Giotto's Franciscan work at Assisi:

matters.text: My little sisters, the birds, much bounden are ye unto God, your Creator, and always in every place ought ye to praise Him, for that He hath given you liberty to fly about everywhere

source.author: Francis of Assisi
source.title: Sermon to the birds, as told in the Fioretti (The Little Flowers of St Francis)
